result.summary: Root-cause diagnosis complete for ISS-0709/GH#799: the 10 failing VLD-01/02/03 in-file tests collapse into 5 root causes. R1 site.zig freeSites leaks the []Site backing from enumerateSites' toOwnedSlice (3 site tests + pd06 malformed test — all pure leak panics; enumeration logic is correct). R2 TypedEnv.deinit double-frees a borrowed ArrayList backing in the two typecheck tests ('Invalid free' panic; checkSite logic correct). R3 env.zig mapDeclaredTypeName('number') returns null -> spurious UnknownVariableType + 'amount' absent from env -> clean-path 'expected 0, found 3' and the unknown-var no-suggestion failures. R4 PD-06 gate under-detection (graph.isValidCelSyntax is delimiter-balance-only and accepts 'amount >'/'x <' dangling operators) plus mod.zig accumulating env findings BEFORE the gate -> VLD-02 AC4 short-circuit unreachable (malformed-guard + ordering tests). R5 mod.zig per-site loop leaks the []Finding backing from checkSite's toOwnedSlice (secondary leak). Full analysis appended to docs/issues/ISS-0709.json (root_cause_analysis: 10 per-test entries, 5 grouped root causes, fix_scope, one R3 design decision). No src/*.zig modified — diagnosis only.
